title: Instagram began as a check-in app called Burbn
summary: Instagram started as Burbn, a check-in and plans app that users mostly used to share photos. It launched as a photo app on October 6, 2010 with about 25,000 users on day one; Facebook bought it for $1 billion in April 2012 when it had 13 employees.

beats.say: Instagram began as a check in app called Burbn.
Burbn let people check in and post plans, but users mostly shared photos.
So the founders scrapped it and rebuilt the app around photo sharing.
Instagram launched in October two thousand ten.
It drew about twenty five thousand users on its first day.
In April two thousand twelve, Facebook bought Instagram for one billion dollars.
At that point, the team had thirteen employees.
Burbn began as a spare time project in twenty ten.
What people actually did in the app became the product.
A check in app turned into a photo app.
